content.title: Are Any Stores Open On Easter Sunday In Atlanta? Easter Hours For Walmart, Target, Publix, Kroger, Waffle House & More
content.text: If you have to run a quick errand or grab a bite to eat on Easter Sunday, you might be wondering what's open... let us help ya out. Shutterstock This Sunday, April 5th, 2026, is Easter Sunday, a very important holiday in the Christian religion. Many stores in the ATL will be closed in observance, so if you’re looking to see what’s open, search no further! We’ve got you covered. Keep scrolling to see what’s open and what’s closed on Easter Sunday in Atlanta. Shutterstock Is Walmart open on Easter Sunday? Yes. Walmart has announced they will be open on Easter Sunday with regular store hours. Is Kroger open on Easter Sunday? Yes. Kroger has announced they will be open on Easter Sunday with regular store hours. Is Trader Joe’s open on Easter Sunday? Shutterstock Yes. Trader Joe’s has announced they will be open on Easter Sunday with regular store hours. Is Target open on Easter Sunday? No. Targets is closed on Easter Sunday. Is Publix open on Easter Sunday? Shutterstock No. Publixes are closed on Easter Sunday. Is Waffle House open on Easter Sunday? Shutterstock Yes. Waffle House will be open on Easter Sunday, but check your local Waffle House before you go in case of store hours changing for the holiday. Is CVS open on Easter Sunday? Yes. Walmart has announced they will be open on Easter Sunday, but hours will vary by location. Check before you go. What is closed on Easter Sunday? Here are some of the stores that will be closed on Easter Sunday, in Alphabetical order: Aldi Best Buy Burlington Costco The Honey Baked Ham Company Hobby Lobby HomeGoods Lowe’s Marshalls Sam’s Club Staples SuperCuts T.J. Maxx What is open on Easter Sunday? Bunny Photo Time at Town Center at Cobb And if you’re looking for some spots that will be open on Easter Sunday, here are a few spots: Dollar General Home Depot IKEA Old Navy Petco PetSmart Rite Aid Safeway Starbucks Walgreens Whole Foods Happy Easter, Atlanta!
